'''Krett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who commanded a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the end of the war, he was exiled to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] where he established the [[Federation's Folly]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the city of [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]].
